requirements.source_text: We are seeking a Junior Software Developer who is curious, motivated, and excited to grow in a collaborative technical environment.
You enjoy learning new technologies, solving problems, and turning business requirements into practical software solutions.
You may be early in your career, but you bring strong fundamentals, a willingness to ask thoughtful questions, and a commitment to building reliable, high-quality work.
Contribute to the design, development, testing, and support of client solutions in collaboration with senior developers and project teams.
Work within an Agile development environment, following team processes, coding standards, and delivery best practices.
Break down problems into smaller tasks and seek guidance when needed to prioritize and move work forward.
Create and maintain as-built documentation for client solutions.
Build and update technical support documentation for internal teams and client solutions.
Support testing and quality assurance activities by reviewing functionality, documenting issues, and helping validate fixes.
Develop software components and solutions using Microsoft technologies, including the Power Platform, with support from experienced team members.
Communicate questions, blockers, risks, or delays early so the team can support successful project delivery.
Post-secondary education in Computer Science, Software Development, Information Technology, or a related program, or equivalent practical experience.
Approximately 0–2 years of software development experience, including internships, co-op placements, academic projects, personal projects, or professional experience.
Foundational experience with at least one programming language, such as C#, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, or a similar language.
Basic familiarity with version control tools such as Git.
Interest in Microsoft cloud technologies, including Power Platform, Azure, Microsoft 365, SharePoint.
Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
Clear verbal and written communication skills, with a willingness to ask questions and share progress openly.
Exposure to Agile development practices through work, school, or project experience.
Experience with Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, or Power Platform.
Experience with C#, PowerShell, Bash, APIs, databases, or web development frameworks.
Previous experience working on client-facing, consulting, or team-based software projects.

We are seeking a Junior Software Developer who is curious, motivated, and excited to grow in a collaborative technical environment.
You enjoy learning new technologies, solving problems, and turning business requirements into practical software solutions.
You may be early in your career, but you bring strong fundamentals, a willingness to ask thoughtful questions, and a commitment to building reliable, high-quality work.
Help design, build, test, and support client software alongside senior developers and project teams.
Use Agile team workflows and follow the team's processes, code standards, and delivery practices.
Divide problems into manageable tasks and ask for guidance when priorities or next steps are unclear.
Write and keep current as-built records for client solutions.
Prepare and maintain technical support guides for internal teams and client work.
Review software behavior, record issues, and help verify fixes as part of testing and QA.
With experienced colleagues' support, build software components with Microsoft tools such as the Power Platform.
Raise questions, risks, delays, and blockers promptly so the team can keep project work on track.
Complete post-secondary study in Computer Science, Software Development, IT, or a related area, or have equivalent hands-on experience.
Have about zero to two years of software-development experience, which may come from internships, co-op, school or personal projects, or paid work.
Have basic experience with one or more programming languages, for example C#, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, or a comparable language.
Know the basics of version control tools, for example Git.
Be interested in Microsoft's cloud tools, such as Power Platform, Azure, Microsoft 365, or SharePoint.
Be able to work on your own and cooperate with a team.
Communicate clearly in speech and writing, ask questions, and share progress with the team.
Have encountered Agile software practices in a job, school, or project setting.
Have used one or more of Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, or Power Platform.
Have worked with C#, PowerShell, Bash, APIs, databases, or web frameworks.
Have prior software project experience with clients, consulting work, or a team.
